title: Extract CMS distribution and resource metadata
objective: All 159 baseline CMS entries expose evidence-backed distribution/resource candidates without asserting payload success.
outcome: Cost-report fixture distinguishes product-level coverage from the 2023 distribution and later metadata modification. Linked API/CSV/PDF/XLSX dictionary and landing-page resources carry literal locator evidence. Duplicate links deduplicate by capture identity. All 159 IDs have a reconciled cause-ledger row; a missing dictionary locator remains unresolved rather than dictionary-absent.

commits.subject: Bind CMS catalog resources exactly
commits.instructions: Use captured dataset identifiers, resourcesAPI links and distribution objects; preserve title, temporal, modified and format fields in their proper roles.
commits.verification: A cost-report fixture distinguishes product-level coverage from the 2023 distribution and its later metadata modification.

commits.subject: Extract dictionary and access candidates
commits.instructions: Classify linked API, CSV, PDF/XLSX dictionary and landing-page resources with literal locator evidence. Reuse existing CMS resource collection.
commits.verification: Every selected locator traces to its catalog/resource pointer; duplicate links deduplicate by capture identity, not product identity.

commits.subject: Produce the CMS cause ledger
commits.instructions: Run the adapter across 159 IDs and report resource counts, missing locators, parser families, eligibility and next action.
commits.verification: All 159 have a reconciled row; a missing dictionary locator remains unresolved rather than dictionary-absent.
